message.content: {"caption":"A workflow diagram showing how a model gathers experience, stores successful and failed episodes, and uses a skill library to improve its behavior.","description":"The upper light-blue workflow begins with an orange fish labeled “Base Model” and a globe labeled “Environment,” linked by a pair of circular arrows. A right-pointing arrow leads from the environment to a “Trajectory” drawn as a sequence of steps, a₁, a₂, …, aₙ. Dashed arrows branch from the trajectory to a green check labeled “Successful Episodes” and an orange-red X labeled “Lessons from Failure”; a right-pointing arrow then leads to a black cube labeled “Memory.” A connector descends from Memory and points to a folder labeled “Skills.” In the lower panel, an “Evolved Model” fish with a flame icon is to the left of an “Environment” globe and an “SFT Model” fish. A left-pointing arrow connects the environment to the Evolved Model; circular arrows sit between the environment and SFT Model. “Cold Start,” beside a gray bent/downward arrow, is marked above the SFT Model. A red return path runs across above the lower models and has a downward arrow over the Evolved Model. To the right, the Skills library is divided into “General Skills” and “Task-Specific Skills.” An orange connector from General Skills points left toward the SFT Model. An orange branching connector from General Skills leads to an orange network-node icon and the guidance “Take what you see,” and to a document-and-magnifier icon beside “Prioritize exploring unvisited nodes.” A blue right-pointing arrow and magnifying-glass icon appear between the SFT Model and Task-Specific Skills. From Task-Specific Skills, a connector leads to a small process icon and the green instruction box: “For cleaning tasks, follow this process: Locate -> Obtain -> Clean the pool -> Place this item.” Along the bottom, blue connector lines descend from the Evolved Model and Environment and run beneath the workflow; upward arrowheads point into the SFT Model and Task-Specific Skills. The line is annotated with a flame and “Update SkillBank,” followed by a plus icon and “Create New or Refine,” with a small edit icon at the end.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
